codeine.name: Codeine
codeine.cpic_note: CPIC: avoid codeine in UM and PM phenotypes.
codeine.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and Opioids (2021)

tramadol.name: Tramadol
tramadol.cpic_note: CPIC: avoid tramadol in UM and PM phenotypes.
tramadol.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and Opioids (2021)

hydrocodone.name: Hydrocodone
hydrocodone.cpic_note: CPIC: consider alternative for PM phenotypes.
hydrocodone.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and Opioids (2021)

oxycodone.name: Oxycodone
oxycodone.cpic_note: CPIC: caution with CYP3A4 inhibitors/poor metabolizers.

pregabalin.name: Pregabalin
pregabalin.cpic_note: CPIC: no PGx-based dosing changes required.

duloxetine.name: Duloxetine
duloxetine.cpic_note: CPIC: consider dose reduction in PM phenotypes.
duloxetine.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and Opioids (2021)

clopidogrel.name: Clopidogrel
clopidogrel.cpic_note: CPIC: avoid in IM and PM CYP2C19 phenotypes.
clopidogrel.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2C19 and Clopidogrel (2022 Update)

citalopram.name: Citalopram
citalopram.cpic_note: CPIC 2023: PM reduce dose by 50%, max 20mg/day (QT prolongation risk). UM consider alternative.
citalopram.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2C19 and SSRIs (2023)

escitalopram.name: Escitalopram
escitalopram.cpic_note: CPIC 2023: PM reduce dose by 50%. UM consider alternative.
escitalopram.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2C19 and SSRIs (2023)

sertraline.name: Sertraline
sertraline.pathway: Sertraline → N-desmethylsertraline (CYP2C19 primary, multiple minor pathways)
sertraline.cpic_note: CPIC 2023: PM consider 50% dose reduction or alternative. No adjustment needed for UM.
sertraline.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2C19 and SSRIs (2023)

paroxetine.name: Paroxetine
paroxetine.cpic_note: CPIC 2023: UM consider alternative. PM reduce dose by 50%.
paroxetine.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and SSRIs (2023)

prasugrel.name: Prasugrel
prasugrel.pathway: Prasugrel → active metabolite (CYP3A4 primary, CYP2B6 secondary)
prasugrel.cpic_note: CPIC 2022: recommended alternative to clopidogrel in CYP2C19 IM/PM. Not affected by CYP2C19 status.
prasugrel.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2C19 and Clopidogrel (2022 Update)

ticagrelor.name: Ticagrelor
ticagrelor.pathway: Ticagrelor → active metabolite (CYP3A4, not a prodrug; direct-acting P2Y12 inhibitor)
ticagrelor.cpic_note: CPIC 2022: recommended alternative to clopidogrel. Not affected by CYP2C19 genotype.
ticagrelor.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2C19 and Clopidogrel (2022 Update)

acetaminophen.name: Acetaminophen
acetaminophen.cpic_note: No PGx-based dosing changes required. Used as alternative when CYP-mediated drugs are contraindicated.

fluvoxamine.name: Fluvoxamine
fluvoxamine.cpic_note: CPIC 2023: PM consider 25-50% lower dose. UM no recommendation (no data).
fluvoxamine.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and SSRIs (2023)

fluoxetine.name: Fluoxetine
fluoxetine.cpic_note: CPIC 2023: No gene-based dosing recommendation due to multiple metabolic pathways. Monitor UM/PM more closely.
fluoxetine.source_citation: Bousman et al. 2023, PMID 37032427; Hicks et al. 2015, PMID 25974703

simvastatin.name: Simvastatin
simvastatin.pathway: Simvastatin → simvastatin acid (hepatic uptake via SLCO1B1, CYP3A4 metabolism)
simvastatin.cpic_note: CPIC 2022: SLCO1B1 Decreased → alternative statin or limit dose <20 mg/day. Poor → alternative statin (Table 2). Strong evidence.
simvastatin.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for SLCO1B1, ABCG2, CYP2C9 and Statins (2022)

atorvastatin.name: Atorvastatin
atorvastatin.pathway: Atorvastatin → 2-hydroxy atorvastatin (hepatic uptake via SLCO1B1, CYP3A4 metabolism)
atorvastatin.cpic_note: CPIC 2022: SLCO1B1 Decreased → ≤40 mg. Poor → ≤20 mg or consider rosuvastatin/combination therapy (Table 2).
atorvastatin.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for SLCO1B1, ABCG2, CYP2C9 and Statins (2022)

rosuvastatin.name: Rosuvastatin
rosuvastatin.pathway: Rosuvastatin → N-desmethyl rosuvastatin (hepatic uptake via SLCO1B1, efflux via ABCG2, minimal CYP metabolism)
rosuvastatin.cpic_note: CPIC 2022: SLCO1B1 Decreased → aware >20 mg. Poor → ≤20 mg. ABCG2 Poor → ≤20 mg. Combined → ≤10 mg if both Poor (Tables 2, 3, 5).
rosuvastatin.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for SLCO1B1, ABCG2, CYP2C9 and Statins (2022)

fluvastatin.name: Fluvastatin
fluvastatin.pathway: Fluvastatin → 5-hydroxy fluvastatin (hepatic uptake via SLCO1B1, oxidation via CYP2C9)
fluvastatin.cpic_note: CPIC 2022: CYP2C9 IM → ≤40 mg. PM → ≤20 mg. SLCO1B1 Poor → ≤40 mg. Combined: PM + SLCO1B1 Decreased/Poor → alternative agent (Tables 2, 4, 6).
fluvastatin.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for SLCO1B1, ABCG2, CYP2C9 and Statins (2022)
